capabilities: Render image alt text as a centered caption in Reading view
Render captions in Live Preview via CSS while editing
Support external images and internal ![[image]] embeds
Leave images with empty alt text unchanged
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian ignores image alt text, so writing ![caption](image.png) shows nothing under the image.
summary: Image caption plugin that renders Markdown image alt text as a centered caption below the image in Reading view and Live Preview.
